content:
Decimal place value, fraction-decimal conversions and lining up the point — Class 6 decimals are precision marks on every Olympiad paper, and the bridge to money and measurement questions. Here is what the chapter tests, with a free 10-question test.

What the Class 6 Maths Olympiad Decimals chapter tests

  • Place value to thousandths
  • Fraction ↔ decimal conversions
  • Comparing and ordering decimals
  • Addition, subtraction and decimals in money/measures

Key facts your child should know

  • 4.375 = 4 + 3/10 + 7/100 + 5/1000.
  • 0.5 = 0.50 = 0.500 — padding zeros changes nothing.
  • 1/8 = 0.125; 3/4 = 0.75; 1/5 = 0.2.
  • Line up the decimal points before adding or subtracting.

Common mistakes to avoid

  • Comparing 0.5 and 0.45 digit-count-wise (0.5 is greater).
  • Misaligning points in addition.
  • Dropping the zero in answers like 0.07.
